chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr from Jameel ibn Darraj and Dorost from Muhammad ibn Marwan who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no thing except that it has a measure and a weight, except for the tears, for a drop of them extinguishes an ocean of Fire. So whenever the eye overflows with its water, its face will not be covered with soot nor humiliation. So when they overflow, Allah prohibits them upon the Fire, and if a weeper weeps in a community, they would be mercied.'

key_terms.قَتَرٌ: Soot (symbolizing the mark of Hell on the face)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of weeping in Shia Islam according to the hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the unique spiritual metric of tears, noting that while all creation is bound by measure, weeping transcends physical limits to extinguish Hellfire. This tradition underscores the transformative power of sincere grief, where the physical act of shedding tears serves as a divine shield against the soot of humiliation and can even extend mercy to the broader community.

en.hubeali: Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj and Dorost, from Muhammad Bin Marwan who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There is none from the things except that from it is a measurement and a weight except for the tears, for a drop of it can extinguish oceans of fire. So whenever the eyes overflow with its water, its face will neither wear out from be disgraced. So when they overflow, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Prohibits it upon the Fire, and if a weeper in a community was to weep, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Merciful upon it (the whole community)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj and Drust from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘everything has weighing and measuring tools except the tears. A drop of tear can extinguish oceans of fire. If the eye floods with tears, that face will not suffer anything or become humiliated. If the eye overflows with tears, Allah makes it forbidden for the fire to burn it and if a person weeps in a nation, that nation will receive favors.’”
